newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Moody's lowers ratings of three Thai banks.
newsitem.headline: Moody's lowers ratings of three Thai banks.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said in a statement late on Thursday it has lowered its ratings of three Thai banks.
They were Bank of Ayudhya, Thai Military Bank and Siam City Bank.

The agency said its action reflects "the deterioration in the asset quality of the three banks and the anticipated impact that Thailand's weakening financial fundamentals, declining property and stock markets, deepening crisis in the finance company sector and continuing economic slowdown will have".

Bank of Ayudhya's long-term senior debt and deposit ratings were lowered from Baa1 to Baa2, while its subordinated debt was lowered from Baa2 to Baa3. Its short-term deposit rating was lowered from Prime-2 to Prime-3 and its Bank Financial Strength Rating was lowered from D+ to D.
Siam City Bank and Thai Military Bank's long-term senior debt and deposit ratings were lowered from Baa2 to Baa3 and their subordinated debt ratings were lowered from Baa3 to Ba1.
Their Bank Financial Strength Ratings were lowered from D to E+.
Thai Military Bank's short-term deposit rating was lowered from Prime-2 to Prime-3.
Siam City Bank's short-term deposit rating of Prime-3 was confirmed.
